people.name: Barnabas
people.line: A Levite from Cyprus who accompanied Paul on missionary journeys.

people.name: Paul
people.line: Apostle to the Gentiles, author of many NT epistles

translations.web: it seemed good to us, having come to one accord, to choose out men and send them to you with our beloved Barnabas and Paul,
translations.bsb: So we all agreed to choose men to send to you along with our beloved Barnabas and Paul,
translations.kjv: It seemed good unto us, being assembled with one accord, to send chosen men unto you with our beloved Barnabas and Paul,
